We're abandoning ship!<ab(1200)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>Let's do our best.<ab(800)><ed()>

<on()><sp(20)>I'm getting tired of you lot,
so how about you die now.<ab(10000)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Vanish, you nuisance!<ab(10000)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>If you refuse Shin Dragon,

to become Shin Dragon's core.<ab(10000)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Don't forget that.<ab(10000)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Enemy forces are entering the operational area!<ab(800)><off()>

Mark them as targets and wipe them out.<ab(800)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)><color(5)>Saotome<ce()>...
What in the world is he after!

<on()><sp(20)>If his goal were Earth's ruin,
he could simply wait for the <book(77)>Limit of Questions<endbook()> to come.

<on()><sp(20)>Yet why is he gathering <book(51)>Getter Rays<endbook()>
and trying to evolve <book(48)>Shin Dragon<endbook()>!

<on()><sp(20)>Dr. <color(5)>Saotome<ce()> once did research
together with <book(68)>Adroc Thurston<endbook()>,
or so I'd guess.

<on()><sp(20)>That might have a lot to do
with what he's doing now.

<on()><sp(20)>What did Dr. <color(5)>Saotome<ce()> know,
to have made <book(48)>Shin Dragon<endbook()>...!
<on()><sp(20)><color(5)>Berkt<ce()>'s movements are worrying too.

<on()><sp(20)>Yeah... it was almost as if
they'd set their sights on us.

<on()><sp(20)>If left alone, <book(48)>Shin Dragon<endbook()>
will store up even more <book(51)>Getter Rays<endbook()>.
No need to keep coming back.

<on()><sp(20)>Since we've become a nuisance,
maybe they've shifted their priority
to crushing us instead.

<on()><sp(20)>Word's come in from the <book(84)>Tresor Research Institute<endbook()>.
The <book(61)>Nirvash<endbook()>'s spec-up
is apparently ready.
<on()><sp(20)>Sorry, but the <color(4)>Gekko<ce()> is heading back to the <book(84)>Tresor Research Institute<endbook()> for now.
<on()><sp(20)>Yeah, go ahead.

<on()><sp(20)>Wait, <color(4)>Holland<ce()>!
<color(4)>Renton<ce()> said he was getting off
the <color(4)>Gekko<ce()> and left...
<on()><sp(20)>I... what should I do...
<on()><sp(20)>Seems like it's over that thing he's been worried about.
<on()><sp(20)>That damn idiot...!

<on()><sp(20)>Anyone who's free, go find <color(4)>Renton<ce()>.
We can't let the <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> take him...!

<on()><sp(20)>We'll bring back the new <book(61)>Nirvash<endbook()>
and return shortly.
<color(4)>Hayato<ce()>, hold things down till then.

<on()><sp(20)>...
If you mean to apologize, I'd like to hear it.
Why did you suddenly do something like that.
<on()><sp(20)>I only wondered what kind of life <color(5)>Berkt<ce()> has lived.
